modelRouting.reason: Cross-phase ownership and evidence lifecycle remain unresolved

acceptance: Every mission intent has an identity, tenant, purpose, authority, context, lifecycle, and owner reference.
Unauthorized, cross-tenant, expired, and revoked execution requests fail closed.
Every execution record is idempotent and distinguishes requested action from observed outcome.
Evidence records preserve provenance, temporal status, source, verification status, and supersession/revocation state.
Verification is independently recordable and cannot be inferred from worker completion.
Failure, rollback, quarantine, and operator-escalation states are explicit.
All claims remain scoped to IMPLEMENTED, EXECUTED, OBSERVED, VERIFIED, or CONFORMANT based on actual evidence.
Existing full typecheck, unit, build, and reconciliation gates remain green.
